name: streets-of-rage-4
features: Vert+ perspective camera retaining the original horizontal world view
4:3 render targets, preloading screen, menus, and HUD calculations
1920x1440 default GUI canvas and expanded camera/culling height
mobile top/bottom/side filler artwork suppressed at both presentation draw sites
title artwork and main-menu background center-cropped to fill 4:3 while controls remain width-fit
Back and Select button legend aligned to the bottom of the 4:3 menu canvas
proportional 4:3 center crop for all intro and stage videos
isolated More Games analytics event suppressed while Firebase services remain initialized
known_limitations: Other serialized menu roots or per-stage camera values may require follow-up adjustments.
Intro videos are re-encoded and require ffmpeg/ffprobe with libx264.

compatibility.strategy: canonical SOR4.dll fingerprint, strict XABA/XALZ and bigfile structure validation, loose named-record GUI detection with exact before/after contexts, and decoded video properties
notes: The managed target is intentionally locked to the audited 1.4.5 binary; the complete APK, signer, and source are not compatibility gates.
Recognized mixed display states are completed; the optional analytics-cleanup range is non-gating and unfamiliar bytes there are preserved.

The bigfile is not whole-file hash gated: exactly one named GuiNodeData record and one exact original/patched context are required for each background or button-legend target, while all other records are preserved.
APKVision cleanup remains optional and is handled by the shared framework.
FirebaseApp/provider initialization, Remote Config, billing, cloud saves, Play Games, EOS, More Games, and support components are preserved.
